'''September 2000 Geneva tournament''' was a Star Wars CCG local tournament held in Beyond Reality, Geneva, Illinois on 2 September 2000. [[Paul Motz]] won it. It is known from Paul Motz's tournament report.<ref name="tr-d1185">[https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/reports/2000-09-02-geneva-illinois-9-2-00d1185/ geneva-illinois-9-2-00], DeckTech (Paul "Vollerian" Motz, 2 September 2000). Preservation copy: [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/reports/2000-09-02-geneva-illinois-9-2-00d1185/ GitHub Pages].</ref>

* '''Date:''' 2 September 2000
* '''Site:''' Beyond Reality, Geneva, Illinois
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Death Star II]]
* '''Winner:''' [[Paul Motz]]
